g.text: From literature evidence to candidates for aqueous testing
Search by keyword, reconcile records and triage
Verify original measurements and harmonize units
Convert to mol TE/mol where valid.
Log holds and other assay endpoints.
Sort compound effects high to low
Cᵢ = positive molar ORAC-FL mean | Block effects centered at zero
Minimize weighted squared error + ridge penalty (λ = 10) on block effects
Raw weight = (1 / rows per DOI) × max(0.10, 1 / [1 + (CV / 0.25)²])
CV = reported SD / mean. Use multiplier 1 without a typed SD. Normalize weights to mean 1.
Prospective experimental qualification of the retained candidates
